evidence.quote: I said the soak between sites has to be two full weeks, and I said I'd hold us to it. That was wrong. I was wrong on the eighth and I want it struck from the plan.

observations.why: Repeated clause-initial framing ('I said... and I said...', 'That was wrong. I was wrong') emphasizing explicit self-correction.

evidence.quote: rather be defensible and know where the slack isn't than conservative for a reason that turned out to be imaginary

observations.why: Deliberately set matched contrast between being defensible with known constraints versus conservative on false premises.
Sharp, balanced contrasting pair clarifying the operational characterization.
